lines.en: 「Lee Hyunsung was nodding off like the duty officer in a command and control room.」
If this were Ways of Survival, it probably would have described him that way. And perhaps there might have been a sentence like this, too.
「Lee Hyunsung probably had no idea. No idea what would happen to him today.」
“Hyunsung-ssi?”
“······Ah, ahem, I must have dozed off for a moment. Dokja-ssi, did you get some rest?”
“Yes, well, I did. But you were talking in your sleep. Something about the duty officer······.”
“Oh, really?”
“Something about Private Lee Hyunsung······.”
Lee Hyunsung's face flushed red.
“W-well. I still have some trauma from my days as an enlisted soldier.”
“An enlisted soldier? Aren't you an officer, Lee Hyunsung-ssi?”
“Well······I transferred to the Korea Army Academy at Yeongcheon when I was a corporal.”
“I've heard that's pretty rare. Military life must have suited you.”
Lee Hyunsung smiled bitterly. It was a smile I could understand perfectly. Very few people stayed in the military because it suited them. Some stayed because other work didn't suit them.
Then, should I start tossing a few stones?
“Still, I'm glad you're here, Lee Hyunsung-ssi.”
“Pardon?”
“Lee Hyunsung-ssi, I feel reassured when you're up front, holding things off. Like someone's protecting me, I suppose.”
“······Is that so?”
A faint smile appeared on Lee Hyunsung's face. It was a weak smile, but one that clearly showed he'd found some comfort. After a brief goodbye, I moved away from him.

According to the original course of the third round, Lee Hyunsung should have encountered his attribute evolution event while protecting people from the Cheoldoo Group at Geumho Station. But Jung Heewon had taken that opportunity.
Jung Heewon, Yoo Sangah, and Lee Gilyoung had come over before I knew it and were watching me. I faced them and whispered.
“Did you watch the demonstration? Just do what I did.”
“Yes. Well···more or less. But why do we have to do this?”
Why else? Because of that.
[The character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ is beginning to feel a sense of responsibility.]
Watching Lee Hyunsung scrub his iron shield with that innocent face, I realized it all over again.
[Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint] really was a cheat. At least when it came to ‘characters.’
“I thought it might help Hyunsung-ssi. He's seemed rather discouraged lately······. If the people around him give him a little encouragement, wouldn't that help him recover his spirits sooner?”
I spoke as though I truly had Lee Hyunsung's interests at heart. Innocent Yoo Sangah nodded.
“Like ‘Praise Can Make Even a Whale Dance’?”
“Something like that.”
“All right. I'll do my best!”
Unlike Yoo Sangah, Jung Heewon looked a little skeptical.
“Dokja-ssi.”
“Yes.”
“Dokja-ssi, your constellation sponsor wouldn't happen to be something like the ‘One-Eyed Fortune Teller,’ would it?”
“···What's that?”
“Don't you know Gung Ye?”

She certainly had a knack for making up modifiers. For a moment, I wondered whether Jung Heewon might be the author of Ways of Survival, but of course that couldn't be. Because Gung Ye's modifier was ‘One-Eyed Maitreya.’
“It's nothing like that. I have a special skill. Let's just say it's a skill that gives me a good understanding of people.”
“···You probably wouldn't tell me what it is even if I asked, so I won't bother.”
“Thank you.”
“But you haven't used something like that on me, have you?”
I almost let my feelings show on my face. I couldn't begin to say how glad I was that Jung Heewon didn't have [Lie Detection].
I spoke while keeping an eye on Lee Gilyoung's reaction.
“I only use it on men.”
“Oh my.”
It wasn't entirely a lie.
I hadn't read Jung Heewon's inner thoughts yet.
Not yet, anyway.
“Anyway, please make an effort, everyone. Jung Heewon-ssi first, then Yoo Sangah-ssi, and Gilyoung last. Take turns in that order and say something to him whenever you have time.”
“Something like, ‘Oh my, I believe in you, Hyunsung-ssi!’ Right?”
“You don't have to go that far. Anyway, use your judgment.”
“Ugh, this is so cringeworthy I could die. Seriously.”

Cringeworthy or not, we had to do it. Lee Hyunsung's ‘attribute evolution’ was essential to this plan's success. If I'd known Yoo Joonghyuk would act like that, I would have made the plan sooner······. Still, if we worked hard, we should see results before the end of the day, even if it would be cutting things close.
In fact, the others seemed to be doing reasonably well.
“There's something reassuring about how constant you are, Hyunsung-ssi. Like a pine tree, I suppose.”
“Haha, thank you, Heewon-ssi. As it happens, I like the military song ‘Green Pine Tree.’”
[The character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ feels proud.]
“I didn't ask about that.”
[The character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ feels a little dejected.]
“I don't think I've met many people with such a strong sense of justice as you, Hyunsung-ssi.”
“Ah···I wouldn't go that far. Still, thank you, Yoo Sangah-ssi.”
[The character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ is beginning to reflect on justice.]
“Hyunsung-hyung, your muscles are the best.”
“Thanks, kid.”
[The self-esteem of the character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ is increasing.]

To think such soulless compliments worked so well. I couldn't begin to say how glad I was that Lee Hyunsung was such a simple character. After we'd repeated similar conversations a few times, the system messages slowly began to change.
[The character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ is awaiting a catalyst for attribute evolution.]
Good. Things were going smoothly.
Yoo Sangah asked in a slightly worried tone.
“But Hyunsung-ssi seems to be feeling a little pressured······.”
Yoo Sangah really was kind. Even in a situation like this, she probably worried about people's feelings. It was an ability I didn't have.
“He probably is, a little. But I think it's necessary. Some people grow stronger the more burdens they carry, after all.”
“It'll work out, so don't worry. And······Gilyoung, did you look into what I asked?”
“Yes, hyung.”
Lee Gilyoung, who had been waiting right beside me, answered. A pair of cockroaches sat on his little head with their antennae raised.
“They say that noona is on the first basement level.”
“Thanks.”
That was enough for Lee Hyunsung. Now it was time to steal someone else's fighting strength.
I went up the transfer stairs alone. The first to greet me at the top were members of the ‘Landlord Alliance.’
“Haha, look who it is. Our illegal tenant.”
“You've got some nerve coming up here after what you did. I heard you survived without a ‘room’ yesterday. Is that true? Yoo Joonghyuk must have helped you, huh?”
I ignored them and kept walking. Perhaps they thought I was scared, because the alliance members kept sneering.
“Isn't it hard living as Yoo Joonghyuk's lackey? Join our alliance. Pildu-ssi said he'd consider it.”
I walked past, pretending not to hear, and counted the ‘Green Zones’ left on each level. One, two, three······. For this plan to work, I couldn't miss even one.
“On condition that you bring all those women, of course.”
There were eleven Green Zones left in total. Yesterday's scenario seemed to have reduced their number considerably. That left little margin for carrying out the plan.
“Hey, are you ignoring us?”
“I'm listening. Tell him I'll think about it.”
The alliance members looked at each other and snickered at my reply.
Sure, laugh like that while you can.

Leaving those retreating bastards behind, I walked up the escalator. Before I knew it, a blade had appeared from behind and was touching my neck. I'd barely sensed a presence······. There was only one skill that allowed movement this stealthy so early on.
[Ghost Walk].
“I'm disappointed, ajusshi.”
Lee Jihye. She might have no manners, but her abilities were outstanding. The Duke of Loyalty and Warfare hadn't chosen this girl for nothing.
“Ajusshi, you know what'll happen to your women if you make a deal with those bastards, right?”
“Of course I do.”
“And you're doing it anyway? Why didn't you just die yesterday?”
I shrugged.
“Put the sword away. I came to talk.”
“Talk? You came here looking for me?”
“Yes.”

At that, Lee Jihye obediently withdrew her sword. When I turned around, she was already gone from behind me. I could see her standing in the passage leading past the ticket gates on the first basement level, though I had no idea when she'd gotten there. She seemed to have used her footwork to put that distance between us in the meantime.
“What do you want to talk about?”
“Why are you standing there, anyway?”
“Master told me to guard this place.”
“···Guard it?”
“So you can't go past here either, ajusshi.”

Lee Jihye tapped the ticket gate and made a throat-slitting gesture. I looked at the passage extending beyond the gates. The numbers of the exits leading aboveground. But not every numbered exit led to the surface. Suddenly, I had a bad feeling.
······Surely that bastard Yoo Joonghyuk wasn't taking that ‘route,’ was he?
If Yoo Joonghyuk had told her to guard this place, he could have only one objective.

He was taking advantage of the ongoing scenario to secretly clear Chungmuro's ‘hidden dungeon.’ Clearing the hidden dungeon. It sounded good. After all, the protagonist growing stronger wasn't a bad thing for me.
The problem was that the third-round Yoo Joonghyuk couldn't clear that dungeon all the way to the end.
It looked like I'd have to move things along faster.
“I came because I need your help.”
“My help?”
“I'm going to crush Gong Pildu and his group today.”
“···Seriously?”
Lee Jihye looked as though she was trying to gauge my sincerity.
[Your understanding of the character ‘Lee Jihye’ is increasing.]
“You can't do it with your strength, ajusshi. Even if all those losers in your group joined in, you couldn't.”
“Even with your help?”
Lee Jihye abruptly turned her head away, as though her pride had been wounded.

That was understandable. Lee Jihye would already have challenged Gong Pildu on the first day she'd come to this station. And then she would have fled. If Yoo Joonghyuk hadn't appeared just in time to save her, Lee Jihye would have died right there.
“There's a way. A way I can put into action if you help.”
“···Master told me to guard this place.”
“If you don't help, most of the people here will die.”
“They're going to die anyway.”
“Did Yoo Joonghyuk tell you that?”
Lee Jihye's gaze wavered badly.
“The boy who talked to us yesterday died. You know that, right?”
“He might have lived. He could have come running up to us again today, chattering about Yoo Joonghyuk's exploits.”
“Yoo Joonghyuk killed that boy. He killed him even though he could easily have saved him.”

My feelings grew complicated as I spoke. I was spouting such polished bullshit, but I wasn't much different from Yoo Joonghyuk. On the subway, and at Geumho Station······I'd turned my back on people I might have been able to save because my own safety would have been threatened.
But the greater the hypocrite, the more convincing the bullshit they could spout.
“I saw the scenario footage you appeared in while I was on the subway.”
Lee Jihye's small shoulders flinched.
“It showed you killing a classmate and surviving.”
“You probably never wanted to do that.”
[The character ‘Lee Jihye’ is deeply shaken.]
“What do you know, ajusshi?”
“What would I know? Of course I don't know. I'm just saying whatever I please.”
“But since I'm saying whatever I please, there's something I really want to tell you. If you turn your back on today, you'll regret it for the rest of your life. I guarantee it.”
[The character ‘Lee Jihye’ is falling into deep anguish.]

I didn't know Lee Jihye the ‘person’ very well, but I knew Lee Jihye the ‘character’ well. Left as she was, this girl would become Yoo Joonghyuk's loyal subordinate. But that was a story for the future. It hadn't happened yet. She admired Yoo Joonghyuk's strength, but she was fundamentally different from him.
It was several minutes later that Lee Jihye spoke.
“If I help, can people survive?”
“Not everyone, but quite a lot will survive.”
“···What do I have to do?”
“We'll start at seven this evening.”
I told her the plan. Only the things Lee Jihye needed to do to put it into action.
Lee Jihye, who'd been listening silently, gaped in bewilderment.
“Are you out of your mind? You're really going to do that?”
“Yes.”
“······Honestly, I don't think it'll work. Just so you know, I haven't said I'll help yet.”
“The choice is yours.”
She might say that, but Lee Jihye would definitely act.
That ill-mannered brat hadn't been chosen by the Duke of Loyalty and Warfare for nothing.
[The constellation ‘Secretive Plotter’ likes your shamelessness.]
[You have received a donation of 100 coins.]
[Lee Jihye's constellation sponsor takes a liking to you.]
[You have received an additional donation of 100 coins.]
Now all the preparations were complete.
At last, the appointed time arrived.
I gathered with the others on the Line 3 platform. They were each checking their weapons. Lee Hyunsung seemed to have taken care of the job properly.
“I've handed them all out as you asked, Dokja-ssi.”

The weapons we'd been using were badly worn, so I'd asked Lee Hyunsung to make new ones. The material came from the grade-8 subterranean creature [groll] we'd taken down during last night's desperate battle. Swords and spears carved from [groll] horns. These wouldn't last long either, but they'd do as a temporary measure.
Jung Heewon smiled in apparent satisfaction.
“This is much lighter and sturdier, isn't it?”
“Ah······Dokja-ssi, Hyunsung-ssi. Thank you so much.”

Yoo Sangah bowed her head as well. Since [groll] horns couldn't be made into blunt weapons, Lee Gilyoung alone was still holding his ground rat weapon. He was silently looking down at the floor. Look at the little guy sulking······. I stroked Lee Gilyoung's head and spoke.
“This won't be easy. It could become even more dangerous than yesterday. Is everyone ready?”
The others nodded solemnly.
“Then let's proceed according to the plan.”

From here on, it was a race against time, so we had to get things done as quickly as possible. Before the ‘Landlord Alliance’ realized what was happening. Once Jung Heewon, Yoo Sangah, and Lee Gilyoung had disappeared to their assigned levels for their respective tasks, I began climbing the stairs with Lee Hyunsung.
Lee Hyunsung spoke in an uncertain voice.
“Dokja-ssi, I don't know whether this will work.”
···You're the key to this operation. You can't go saying things like that. I deliberately answered in an even firmer voice.
“It has to work.”
But Lee Hyunsung still looked intimidated.
“Everyone seems to be relying on me more than I expected, and it's weighing on me. I don't know whether I can do this well.”
“You're someone worth relying on, Hyunsung-ssi.”
“···Thank you for saying that. To be honest, this is a first for me. Even in the military, nobody ever put this kind of trust in me.”
That was something I'd never heard before. Come to think of it, I didn't really know anything about Lee Hyunsung's military life. Ways of Survival only mentioned it briefly in passing.
“Once this is over, I'd like to hear your story, Hyunsung-ssi.”
I'd said it casually in passing, but Lee Hyunsung seemed more affected than I'd expected.
[The character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ is beginning to open his heart to you.]
[Your understanding of the character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ is increasing significantly.]
“Sometimes, when I'm talking to you, Dokja-ssi, I get a strange feeling.”
“Pardon? What kind of···?”
“As though you've known me for a long time······I can't explain it very well, but······.”
Lee Hyunsung scratched his cheek vigorously, trailing off.
“Ah, I didn't mean anything strange by that. All I meant was······.”
“Yes, I know what you mean.”
“Thank you. Talking like this makes me curious about your story too, Dokja-ssi.”
“My story?”
“Yes. I've never met anyone as remarkable as you, Dokja-ssi. I'm curious about all sorts of things, like what you did before all this happened.”
Somehow, I felt a little strange. A ‘supporting character’ in the novel I'd read was beginning to wonder about me. It felt a little unsettling, yet ticklish.
“It probably won't be a very interesting story.”
“I'd still like to hear it.”
Suddenly, a question crossed my mind.
Had ‘Lee Hyunsung’ been living in the same world as me even before ‘Ways of Survival’ became reality?
Or was he someone who had suddenly ‘come into existence’ when the novel became reality?
I couldn't know the answer. All I knew for certain was that, either way, Lee Hyunsung was now a ‘living person,’ and he was right in front of me······. That was all.
“Oh, Yoo Joonghyuk's friend. Here to negotiate?”
It was then that a group of middle-aged men approached from ahead.
There they were. The Landlord Alliance.
“Hmm······But where are the ladies?”
The middle-aged man speaking had a fistful of a woman's hair. She was one of the group that had owned a five-person ‘Green Zone’ until just yesterday.
Perhaps noticing my gaze, the man gave a little smirk.
“Ah, this one's refusing to sell her land······. You don't need to worry about her.”
“P-please save me. Save me!”
The woman's eyes looked at me pitifully. The ‘Absolute Good’ constellations began clamoring in my head. But I waited. Because there was someone here who needed to step forward in my place.
“Let her go.”
It was Lee Hyunsung.
“Who the hell are you?”
At the middle-aged man's sneering question, Lee Hyunsung looked at me. His gaze seemed to seek permission. I nodded.
[The character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ wishes to uphold justice of his own free will.]
[The attribute evolution of the character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ is imminent.]
The alliance members drew their weapons, exuding menace. I checked the time. Then, should we get started? I used my spare coins to raise my stats.
[Investing 1200 coins in ‘Constitution.’]
[Constitution Lv.15 -> Constitution Lv.18]
[Constitution level increases!]
[Investing 1200 coins in ‘Strength.’]
[Strength Lv.15 -> Strength Lv.18]
[Strength level increases!]
Here, I had to get the greatest possible effect from the smallest investment.
[Coins held : 20,350 C]
Because there was somewhere I absolutely had to spend the remaining coins.
BOOOOM!
Small explosions sounded from various parts of the subway station. Disturbances great and small followed. It was the signal from the others.
“Hyunsung-ssi!”
Lee Hyunsung nodded. We charged straight at the men in the front row. The startled alliance members shouted.
“What the hell, you bastards!”
[The exclusive skill ‘White Pure Star Energy’ activates!]
Slash!
“Aaaaargh!”

The arm of the middle-aged man who'd been holding the woman's hair flew through the air. The men froze for a moment at the blood spurting like a fountain. Lee Hyunsung and I ignored them and ran. Belatedly coming to their senses, the middle-aged men chased us.
“Those crazy bastards! Stop them!”
The corridor on the second basement level. Gong Pildu's ‘Private Property’ was just ahead.
[You have trespassed on private property!]
“Surround them!”

The Landlord Alliance members waiting ahead spotted us. Perhaps some of their members were absent, because there were fewer than I'd expected. Twenty behind us, twelve ahead. Still a lot for two people to handle.
Well, I wasn't planning to handle them anyway.
Just as we were about to collide with the alliance members at the front, Lee Hyunsung stepped ahead of me, leading with his iron shield.
[The character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ uses the stigma ‘Great Mountain Push Lv.1’!]
CRAAAASH!
Charging with his tremendous strength, Lee Hyunsung began barreling forward, knocking the men down like dominoes.
[The stigma 「Armed Zone Lv.4」 of the character ‘Gong Pildu’ activates!]

Immediately, turrets began rising throughout the private property. Charged with bright red magic bullets, the turrets were preparing to fire. There were five mini turrets in total. Armed Zone's level seemed to have risen again in the meantime.
“Dokja-ssi!”
I moved past Lee Hyunsung, taking his iron shield at the same time. The moment I felt the solid shield settle into my grip, a heavy impact shoved me backward.
Bang! Boom! Booom!
It felt as heavy as a cannonball hitting me. Pain shot through the arm holding the shield. As expected, Armed Zone backed by level-19 Magic Power was powerful. But now, I could withstand it.
[The bonus effect of the item ‘Unbreakable Faith’ has raised your Constitution level above 20.]
[A higher degree of toughness protects your body.]
“The insolent tenant has arrived.”
Gong Pildu's gruff voice came from beyond the shield.

With the powerful magic bullets pinning us down, confidence was returning to the alliance members' faces. The iron shield was being gouged away, its durability dwindling. It could probably block only another ten to fifteen shots.
Gong Pildu spoke as though intrigued.
“Considering you've come armed, I doubt you're here to pay your fine. What do you want?”
“I'm done being a tenant.”
“Interesting. Do you covet my land?”
“Well. It's not so much that.”
[The ‘Private Property’ effect of the character ‘Gong Pildu’ partially reduces the trespassers' stats.]
······It had begun. This was precisely what made Gong Pildu's abilities frightening. The ‘Private Property’ debuff, followed by the special fortress-defense (守城) effect of ‘Armed Zone.’
Red magic power began condensing in the turrets' red-hot barrels.
[The ‘Mini Turrets’ of the character ‘Gong Pildu’ are preparing ‘Enhanced Magic Bullets.’]
At least in the early stages, there were almost no incarnations who could face Gong Pildu unless the combination of ‘Private Property’ and ‘Armed Zone’ was broken.
“Die.”
At the very moment the enhanced magic bullets were about to fire, screams sounded in the distance. Landlord Alliance members with injuries all over their bodies were frantically running toward us.
“P-Pildu-ssi! The land······!”
Wounds left by a sharp longsword. Lee Jihye had acted.
Now it was time. I looked at Lee Hyunsung.
“Hyunsung-ssi, now.”
Lee Hyunsung's eyes were trembling.
“Smash it all.”
As though he'd been waiting for those words, Lee Hyunsung raised his fist high. A gaze filled with anxiety and apprehension, yet at the same time, an expression of firm resolve not to back down.
[The attribute of the character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ evolves!]
With a dazzling burst of light, a silver aura began swirling around Lee Hyunsung's body.
I watched the sight, feeling a little moved. Lee Hyunsung's ‘attribute evolution’ was one of my favorite scenes in ‘Ways of Survival.’
The reason ‘Lee Hyunsung,’ the Steel Sword Emperor, could be one of the strongest supporting characters. It was―
[Attribute evolution unlocks a new stigma.]
Because, at least when it came to this ‘single blow,’ Lee Hyunsung ranked among the strongest in ‘Ways of Survival.’
[The character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ uses the stigma ‘Great Mountain Smash Lv.1’!]
The magic power gathering in Lee Hyunsung's fist condensed and turned pure white, and then his arm began swelling to a size that defied all common sense.
“Haaaaaah!”
Lee Hyunsung drove his fist straight into the floor.
BOOOOOM―!
An ear-splitting blast swept through the surroundings, and fragments of the shattered floor flew into the air. The horrified alliance members screamed.
“Wh-what the hell!”
CRAAAACK!

Dangerous cracks raced across the floor in an instant, and the turrets began tilting out of position. Misfired magic bullets exploded in the wrong places. The explosions spread, and thick clouds of dust engulfed everything. Then, a moment later.
RUMBLE-RUMBLE!
With a tremendous tremor, the ground beneath the second basement level began to collapse.
[The ‘Green Zone’ has been destroyed.]
[The ‘Private Property’ of the character ‘Gong Pildu’ has been destroyed.]
Watching the floor collapse, I flashed a grin at Gong Pildu, whose face had gone deathly pale.
“Let's go back to the days when we didn't own any land.”
I couldn't kill Gong Pildu because he would be useful in the scenarios, but I couldn't make him walk off his own land either.
When solving a troublesome dilemma like this, focusing on the dilemma's premise could be more helpful.
For instance, if the problem was that he was inside his ‘Private Property,’ all I had to do was destroy that ‘Private Property’ itself.
“Ugh······G-get me out.”
“Fucking hell······.”

This method, however, required tremendous force. Overwhelming force capable of destroying an enormous stretch of ‘Private Property’ with a single blow. That was why I'd hurried Lee Hyunsung's evolution.
“Uuurgh······.”
People who'd fallen to the third basement level and been pinned beneath the collapsed flooring were groaning.
The operation had succeeded.

The ‘Green Zone’ was gone, and the landlords had lost their ‘rooms.’ Through the dust, Gong Pildu was staring at us with a face twisted in rage. Just as he was about to speak, Bihyung's voice reached my ears first.
[What the hell are you doing! Aaaaah!]
‘Be quiet.’
[You lunatic! The Chungmuro dokkaebis are going crazy because of you!]
The constellation messages already resounding in my head were enough to give me a headache.
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ likes your rampage.]
[The constellation ‘Bald General of Justice’ likes your revolution.]
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ likes destruction and chaos.]
[You have received a donation of 300 coins.]
“G-get that bastard!”
“Kill him!”
Getting to their feet one by one, the alliance members shouted at us.
I began running toward the platform on the level below with Lee Hyunsung.
[Activating the exclusive skill ‘Character List’!]
<Character Summary List>
Character : Lee Hyunsung
Attribute : Person who has Regained Justice (Rare)
Stigmas : [Great Mountain Smash Lv.1], [Great Mountain Push Lv.2]
Exclusive Skills : [Bayonet Skills Lv.2], [Camouflage Lv.2], [Patience Lv.1], [Sense of Justice Lv.2], [Weapons Training Lv.3]

Lee Hyunsung's evolution had succeeded without incident. Strictly speaking, this was only his first step, but the fact that he could now use ‘Great Mountain Smash’ would greatly strengthen our group's fighting power.
“Hyunsung-ssi, how many more times can you use it?”
“······I think once or twice at most.”
Lee Hyunsung was panting and looked quite exhausted.

That was only natural. A stigma on the level of ‘Great Mountain Smash’ was a sort of ultimate move that consumed enormous amounts of stamina and magic power. In terms of sheer physical force, there weren't many physical enhancement skills that surpassed ‘Great Mountain Smash.’
I saw the others, who had been scattered throughout the underground levels, running toward us. I called out to Yoo Sangah, who was in the lead.
“Is there anywhere you haven't destroyed?”
“We've destroyed them all!”
“I had no idea ‘rooms’ could be destroyed like that. We all kept pounding the entire floor, and it just collapsed―like that······”
Jung Heewon, who'd come up behind her, added.

Yoo Sangah, Jung Heewon, and Lee Gilyoung had each been assigned small ‘Green Zones.’ Apart from Gong Pildu's ‘Green Zone,’ most of the Green Zones held fewer than three people. Some were awkwardly sized, but I had someone else to deal with those.
[Hey! Can't you hear me? What are you going to do now!]
Meanwhile, Bihyung was still making a fuss over ‘Dokkaebi Communication.’
‘What are you worried about?’
[Have you forgotten? My ‘channel’ isn't the only one in Chungmuro. Do you really have no idea what happens when you pull something like this?]
Of course I knew. The constellations in the channel hosting ‘Gong Pildu’ were probably going wild right now.
‘Whose channel is Gong Pildu in?’
[···Biryu's channel. BIR-3642.]
‘Biryu? The dokkaebi who came in your place a little while ago?’
[That's right. That bastard.]
‘What's the makeup of the subscribing constellations?’
[The ‘fun-seeking’ crowd makes up the bulk of that channel.]

A dokkaebi whose main audience was the ‘fun-seeking’ crowd. So that was why the broadcast had been so extreme back then. Good. In that case, the reaction in the channel would be far more heated than I'd expected. They must all have had their fill of frustration.
When we went down to the Line 4 transfer stairs, I saw a welcome face. A casually held longsword was swishing through the air.
“Did you destroy them all?”
“Yeah. It was easy.”

Lee Jihye had been assigned the ‘Green Zones’ that held five to eight people. I'd left the ones that would be difficult for Jung Heewon alone to subdue to her. Such strength truly befitted Yoo Joonghyuk's disciple—no, the incarnation of the Holy Hero (聖雄). With that, there were no ‘Green Zones’ left in Chungmuro.
“But what are you going to do now? Those bastards are going to come charging like crazy. Ah, here they come.”
Lee Jihye looked behind me and smirked.
“Just so you know, I'm not helping this time.”
“I wasn't expecting you to.”
As Lee Jihye swiftly withdrew, Jung Heewon shot her a sidelong glare.
“What's with her?”
Come to think of it, Jung Heewon probably didn't know about Lee Jihye. But there was no time to explain.
[Ha······You're fucked now, man.]
Along with Bihyung's words, a system message sounded.
[A bounty scenario has been generated!]
<Bounty Scenario – Assassination Commission>
Category : Sub
Difficulty : C
Clear Conditions : The constellations belonging to channel #BIR-3642 have requested the murder of a specific individual. Eliminate ‘Kim Dokja’ at Chungmuro Station.
Time Limit : 10 minutes
Reward : 2000 coins
Failure : None
Just as I'd expected, this was how things had unfolded.
Things were getting very interesting.
